description: Sealed cast-aluminium enclosure body: a downward cavity closed by a bolt-on lid, recessed and ribbed panels on every large face, and one connector land on the +X end. A working demonstration of DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md, not a placeholder - replace the geometry, keep the shape of the file.

cavity.description: Electronics cavity, opens downward to the lid. Wall thickness, plan radius and rim break all come from lib.features.STYLE - see notes.

panels.description: Recessed panels sunk into every large exterior face (R3), ribbed where the span needs the stiffness back (R6). The +X end carries the connector land instead of a panel.

lid_screws.description: Full-height M4 columns from the roof down to the seal plane, tapped from below. inset and target_pitch drive lib.features.bolt_pattern.

connector.description: Raised land with a bounded rectangular window into the cavity, four M3 blind taps. Land and window sizes are interface numbers - they belong to the connector datasheet, not to the style.

notes: Datum: the -Z seal face. The lid mounts to it and every column ends flush with it.
No radius, wall or chamfer is typed into model.py. STYLE.wall(process, span), STYLE.plan_radius(l, w) and STYLE.edge_break(span, wall) supply them, so a change to lib/features.py propagates here.

The only sizes written down are interface sizes (the connector land and its window) and counts. aperture_radius 2.5 is a rung of the Style break ladder on purpose - see DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md section 3.1.
process must name a lib.features.WALLS key: machined-aluminium, cast-aluminium, sheet-metal, printed-fdm, printed-sls.
Replace every value here with your own part, then rewrite spec.json to match.
